gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Junegull has a retro, friendly swagger, with lowercase built as stout as cast iron capitals and curves pinched shut at the mouth. Its strength is punchy, closed-up display character; Noto Sans Oriya's is plain sans openness.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-osage: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Osage, with its inflated bowls. Beside Junegull's pinched, closed curves, a long page of it would feel unhurried, its sweeping shapes never closing up on the eye.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-: Chunky retro charm up top, then a cooler, contemporary body beneath it. Junegull is best at friendly, pinched-curve display lettering, while Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong is best at sans-serif text with a high-set x-height and gapped rounds.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin: Junegull draws every letter with a marker-like constant line, so it never flickers between thick and thin. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau follows in a sans-serif that is clean and modern, so the heading earns its keep when set big and brief.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa brings see-through openings and a gentle step up to its capitals. Noto Sans PhagsPa and Junegull then split the page: the heading is pinched, retro and closed, while the body stays contemporary and friendly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-phoenic: Modern and open describes Noto Sans Phoenician, whose s curves flare wide at both ends. And Junegull supplies the opposite, with pinched, closed curves and a retro, friendly lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-psalter: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads as professional and approachable, with gaping e mouths and capitals that barely rise. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi can be sized up freely, since its low capitals keep the line quiet beside Junegull's spaghetti-like strokes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Junegull draws with no thick-thin flicker catching the eye, giving its retro, friendly letters a steady, pinched look. But Noto Sans Rejang opens things up, with wide, porthole-like counters and clear gaps in its sans-serif shapes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic is neutral and modern, with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves. Junegull is its foil, matching curves to stems exactly and keeping its letters closed, retro and friendly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-saurash: Junegull is retro and friendly, with a lowercase as stout as cast iron capitals. Beside it, Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps capitals barely above their neighbors and counters open to the outside, so the heading's closed, pinched curves stand out.
